stories.headline: Two of the Finest Horses in the Territory Are Standin' in the Barn, Arms Crossed
stories.read: Jahmyr Gibbs missed a third straight day of Lions practice and Bijan Robinson is doin' the same down in Atlanta, both of 'em reported to camp but refusin' to work 'til somebody writes a bigger number on the ledger. Dan Campbell shrugged it off cold: it'll get done, he ain't even sweatin' it. Doc ain't sweatin' it either, pardner, and neither should you. When a fella holds out for bell-cow money, that is the surest sign on this earth his outfit means to hand him the reins twenty times a Sunday. Let the nervous fellas in your saloon slide 'em down the board over a July squabble, then walk up and take the discount with a straight face.

stories.headline: Deebo Rides Back into the Bay, and That Ain't Good News for San Francisco's Young Guns
stories.read: The 49ers brought Deebo Samuel home Thursday night on a one-year, seven-million-dollar handshake, and they only opened the gate because Ricky Pearsall's knee is swellin' up again on that same bad hinge that cost him eight games last year, with Christian Kirk banged up right alongside him. Read the whole trail, not just the headline: San Francisco does not sign a thirty-year-old veteran in August unless somebody's genuinely laid up. Pearsall was gettin' picked like a settled No. 1 out there and his saddle just got a whole lot less certain, so let another fella pay that price. The real strike is Deebo himself, goin' near dead last in the great land grab, back in Shanahan's wagon with Brock Purdy handin' him the ball on the ground and through the air. That is cheap gold if Pearsall's knee stays cranky.

stories.headline: New Orleans Backs Up the Money Wagon for Chris Olave
stories.read: The Saints handed Olave a four-year extension worth up to a hundred thirty-two million with ninety guaranteed, sixth-highest yearly haul of any receiver in the league. Now here's the part the saloon ain't done the arithmetic on: this fella already saw the sixth-most throws in all of football last season, and he did it while missin' a week with blood clots in his lungs. He's cleared and practicin' full now. Nobody pays a man that kind of gold and then throws it to somebody else, so his cut of the throws is locked in tighter than a bank vault. Olave's still gettin' grabbed like a second-tier hand while he's clearly bein' paid like a first. Take the value while it's sittin' there in plain daylight.
